newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan Semicon 1st-half pretax off 49 pct.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan Semicon 1st-half pretax off 49 pct.

text.p: NOTE - Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co is Taiwan's largest semiconductor maker.
In late June, Taiwan Semiconductor raised its 1997 net profit target by 60.9 percent to T$14.72 billion.
It also raised pretax profit target by 61.1 percent to T$12.923 billion.
Its 1997 sales target rose 15.4 percent to T$40.64 billion from T$35.22 billion.
The company offered no reasons for the profit fall, but analysts had attributed the slide to an overall market decline.
Analysts say the semiconductor market has bottomed out since the second quarter and expect it to recover significantly from the third quarter.
